name: WdHorizontalInVerticalType
description: Specifies the format of horizontal text set within vertical text.

constants.name: wdHorizontalInVerticalNone
constants.description: No formatting is applied to the horizontal text.

constants.name: wdHorizontalInVerticalFitInLine
constants.description: The horizontal text is sized to fit in the line of vertical text.

constants.name: wdHorizontalInVerticalResizeLine
constants.description: The line of vertical text is sized to accommodate the horizontal text.
